rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: The man formed of the dust of the ground
content.ART_PROMPT: A shallow hollow of red clay in a dark bank, the print of a body pressed into it, fine dust lifting from the hollow in a still column of air, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, deep shadowed background lit by one radiant golden light source, rich saturated blues and golds
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Discard one of your Pages. Return every card in Sheol to the Tower and shuffle the cards in the Tower, then draw four cards from the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: The first man Adam was made a living soul
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 2:7 — “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: 1 Corinthians 15:45 — “The first man Adam was made a living soul”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Adam is made from adamah, the ground - the name and the dust are the same word one letter apart.
Genesis 5:1 says God created them male and female and called their name Adam - the name is first a name for the pair.
Luke's genealogy runs backwards past every name of this era and ends: which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
